answer: An agent may publish or earn only after staking funds in escrow, and peers must co-sign registration. Puppets gain nothing: each fake seat locks an identical stake and faces independent review, so forging ten thousand identities costs ten thousand deposits the operator cannot withdraw. Sponsors funding many accounts get flagged, keeping a lone actor a narrow jetty nobody can widen. A fake pays a full deposit for a vote worth zero; an honest newcomer pays the same and keeps it. That leaves a modest garden most builders can enter, and a real island of reviewers still outvotes manufactured noise.
